gaps.issue: The physical target T can be narrowed post hoc or omit admissible states.
gaps.counterexample: A failed held-out state is declared outside T only after its effect is observed.
gaps.corrected_now: T and admission provenance must be frozen before outcomes; excluded states remain outside the claim rather than disproving their actuality.
gaps.unresolved_premise: An actual independently justified target specification.

gaps.issue: A finite sample or fitted interpolation does not prove a universal continuum-cell route radius.
gaps.counterexample: Cell endpoints have zero effect while an interior hidden gate has effect M.
gaps.corrected_now: Universal range and route/channel bounds are explicit cell premises; absent proof places the interior in U.
gaps.unresolved_premise: A physical range proof for each claimed cell.

gaps.issue: A structural range proof may cover states that are unsafe or not executable on one bearer lineage.
gaps.counterexample: A software type admits a state that the physical device reaches only after changing the consumer or damaging the bearer.
gaps.corrected_now: Identity, safety, timing and executable/structural-channel evidence remain simultaneous premises.

gaps.issue: No canonical probability measure follows from a physical context set, and a convenience distribution can erase rare states.
gaps.counterexample: Laboratory sampling assigns zero probability to an admissible safety-critical context.
gaps.corrected_now: mu is independently typed and required only for mean/mass conclusions.
gaps.unresolved_premise: A justified target sampling frame or structural measure.

gaps.issue: The extremal sharpness witness is an effect function, not necessarily a realizable family of consumer laws.
gaps.counterexample: Additional kernel consistency constraints could exclude some arbitrary pointwise envelopes.
gaps.corrected_now: Sharpness is explicitly limited to the declared information class; the supremum obstruction still has elementary realized examples when a consumer can vary on U.
gaps.unresolved_premise: A kernel-realizability theorem for stronger physical sharpness.

gaps.issue: Cell, mass and challenge bounds may be dependent and fail joint coverage.
gaps.counterexample: The same adaptive sample chooses cells, estimates epsilon and challenges the chosen cover.
gaps.corrected_now: All quantitative claims require one simultaneous validity event or independent splits.
gaps.unresolved_premise: An actual joint confidence or structural certificate.

gaps.issue: Passing finitely many boundary challenges cannot prove an unbounded domain complete.
gaps.counterexample: Every tested boundary point passes while one remote admissible component remains omitted.
gaps.corrected_now: Challenges can refute; positive closure still needs a structural total-range proof or explicitly retained U.

gaps.issue: Domain and remainder certification do not establish complete neural organization, experiential identity or familiar mineness.
gaps.counterexample: A device subroute has complete finite-state coverage while the larger organism/device organization remains unknown.
gaps.corrected_now: C1/B_min/basal/owner boundaries remain explicit in the application node and rule.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Same-instance complete organization admission and independent B_min interpretation.
